item.title: Woman, two kids suffer facial burns in Manhattan manhole explosion
item.description: The victims, including a 4-year-old boy and a 2-year-old girl, were injured in the manhole explosion at Warren and Church Sts. in Tribeca shortly before 4 p.m., police said.

item.title: ‘The Wire’ actor Bobby J. Brown dies at 62 in barn fire
item.description: "The Wire" actor Bobby J. Brown is dead at 62 as the result of a barn fire. The incident reportedly occurred when he was jumpstarting a vehicle.

item.description: The Nets organization is staying committed to a development plan built for patience.

item.title: Pink denies separation from husband, sarcastically thanks media for letting her know
item.description: Rock & roll superstar Pink had no idea she and husband Carey Hart were on the skids until she read about in the “trash media,” the singer said Thursday.
